correctness.rationale: The graph distance is 3 minus intersection dimension; the exact intersection array and known three-harmonic Grassmann decomposition yield the checked A1,A2,A3 eigenvalues. All nonconstant powered-distance branches were analyzed: j1 strictly decreases from -1; j3 stays negative through p=1, including a separate binary concavity bound; j2 increases through zero exactly once in (0,1). This establishes necessary/sufficient CND and Gaussian positivity for every prime power and n>=6, endpoint nullity m2, and minimal Euclidean rank. The full algebra was symbolically checked, and a standalone script reproduced the recurrence in 37 cases and all binary six-dimensional three-spaces, including graph BFS. Finite tests are supplementary; no infinite claim relies solely on enumeration.

value.rationale: The first diameter-three finite-field Grassmannian is a natural sharp Schoenberg exponent problem beyond strongly regular two-subspace cases. Its complete parameter classification singles out a middle-harmonic obstruction, identifies the precise critical embedding rank, and proves exponential decay with ambient dimension. These results are motivated kernel and embedding invariants, not arbitrary finite census or a mere restatement of known incidence eigenvalues.
